Single-purchase test build
1. Enable the AutoPilot accessibility service.
2. Start capture, open the game and wait for its upgrade bar.
3. Return here and calibrate the three green-banknote controls.
4. Resume capture, then choose ONE purchase test.
Automatic buying and Rebirth Rush are not enabled.
